text:
sanjay: spotting a spike in PO/invoice ingest failures from the GCP marketplace connector starting ~09:12 UTC. verifier is rejecting attachments with a fingerprint format mismatch.

maria: is this only for one partner or multiple?

sanjay: two partners primarily impacted: Orbitrix and NovaEdge. roughly 30% of inbound POs for those partners failing ingestion.

emma: could this be caused by key rotation or a metadata shape change on their side? we tightened fingerprint validation earlier this month.

josh: infra quick-check: our verifier expects `sha256:keyid:version`. incoming payloads from GCP show `sha256:BASE64SIG` (no keyid/version). parser bails early.

maria: finance is flagging stuck POs. can we do a temporary acceptance?

josh: we can deploy a permissive fallback that accepts the older format and continues verification heuristically. I'd prefer a short canary first. deploy is ~10m plus tests.

sanjay: go ahead. @josh open a canary and tag me. I'll draft the partner communication.

josh: deploying canary branch `hotfix/ledger-fallback` now: `deploy canary permissive-verify --tag=hotfix/ledger-fallback`.

marketplace-bot: deploy started by josh at 2024-11-22T10:05:12Z — health checks pending

emma: legal: temporary acceptance ok? @sara_legal?

sara_legal: short answer: acceptable under controls. requirements: 1) log full raw payloads for audit, 2) partner signs simple addendum acknowledging key rotation and agreeing to update marketplace metadata, 3) fallback removed after window (we recommend 4 hours). I'll prepare a one-click email template.

maria: perfect. Sanjay, include ETA for AR.

sanjay: ETA: 30–45m for canary verification, then 90m for staged prod rollout if green. will send partner note now.

josh: canary healthy. permissive fallback handling ~120 req/min. sampled traces show successful parsing for previously failing attachments.

marketplace-bot: alert suppressed — failures down 92% over last 15m

maria: can you paste affected PO IDs so billing can reconcile?

josh: sample IDs: PO-88231, PO-88247, PO-88260. full list posted to #support after this thread.

sanjay: Orbitrix replied: "we rotated signing keys last week and forgot to push updated metadata to the marketplace manifest. fixing now."

sara_legal: sending SLA addendum to Orbitrix legal; cc finance + partnerships.

maria: next actions: 1) monitor canary and roll to prod if steady, 2) revoke permissive fallback after partner confirms metadata update, 3) run reconciliation job for stuck POs and re-ingest.

sanjay: filing this as a deal-desk escalation for tracking. @josh @sara_legal please prepare a short postmortem blurb once reconciled. closing thread after reconciliation complete. :white_check_mark:
